notes.title: 🕊️ Prepare to unveil the mysteries of Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🕊️
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Get in your hydraloft in search of the mythical Great White Birds when Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy lands in 2024!

[previewyoutube=lQf1kBoskWw;full][/previewyoutube]

Set off on a quest for the Great White Birds in a mysterious land full of secrets

Answer the call of exploration as you travel to Amerzone, a forgotten Latin American country, to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer.

Investigate the ruins of this secretive land reclaimed by nature, meet intriguing characters with deep backstories and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth.

Will you unveil the mysteries surrounding the mythical Great White Birds?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5618793/bf2500829f737733cdcb5952f413f61ffe3fcf86.jpg

🌱 A remake of the classic Benoît Sokal game
(Re)Discover the work of Benoît Sokal before the Syberia saga

🧭 An ode to exploration
Discover a land shaped by mysteries and secrets as you travel through breathtaking environments

🕊️ Face many challenges in search of the truth
Find clues and solve intricate puzzles to carry your quest for the Great White Birds in a faithful yet enriched story

🤝 Meet fascinating characters
Learn about people with deep backstories, and listen to their stories to mend the errors of the past

🕊️ Wishlist Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy now
